newsitem.title: UK: Crown Leisure joins online lottery venture.
newsitem.headline: Crown Leisure joins online lottery venture.

text.p: British amusement machine supplier Crown Leisure Plc said on Friday it subscribed for a 50 percent stake in an online lottery joint venture with private investors.
Crown said its future stake in Inter Lotto (UK) Ltd would depend on its procuring of funding, although it added that it did not have an obligation to seek funding for the venture.
The company also said it would provide finance to Inter Lotto in the form of an interest-bearing loan not to exceed 400,000 stg.
